source_audit.coverage_years: May 2026 report, with HED second-survey records and correspondence attached
source_audit.granularity: Named structure, proposed/confirmed listing status, and HED reference where stated
source_audit.key_fields: Report date, structure name, address, HED status category, HB reference for appendix records, and confirmation/proposal wording.
source_audit.reliability: strong for council-notified HED listing/proposed-listing/de-listing status; caveated where the report is an advance/proposed status rather than confirmed statutory list entry.

source_audit.ingestion_recommendation: Use confirmed-listing notifications as candidate heritage-status events; reconcile with the nidirect Buildings Database before final ingestion where HB references are absent from the committee summary.
